verdict: Spend is up sharply; revenue efficiency is declining and is being addressed.
narrative: Ad spend rose 54.79% week-over-week to $64.34 per day, but the return on that spend dropped 64% compared to the prior week — costs are outpacing revenue, not the other way around. The 28-day return on ad spend of 5.24x is flattered by a single large-revenue day in late August; recent daily revenue has been well below that spike. We're reviewing budget allocation and ad creative now to bring spend and return back into balance. Your Google Business Profile activity also went dark over the past week, which we're actively investigating. Expect tighter spend controls and a creative refresh to take effect over the next 7 days.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend over the last 28 days — driven largely by one strong day in late August, not a consistent trend
purchases attributed to Meta ads this period, with daily purchase volume flat-to-declining despite higher spend
week-over-week drop in revenue efficiency as ad costs surged without a matching rise in sales

watch_item.issue: Rising ad spend is not producing proportional revenue — the last three days show flat purchase volume on significantly higher daily budget.
watch_item.fix: Budget levels and campaign targeting are under active review this week, and ad creative is being refreshed to counter early signs of audience fatigue.
